text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the stage for my first direct clash with the Golden Generation. Today, I cross blades with…

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder! I answer the spirited gazes of these twin peaks of the Golden Generation with this—"I shall be victorious."

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: And now, ladies and gentlemen, it is time to begin the tumultuous Act II of Origins of the Centurial Overlord!
